comparison.objective: Draw a measured liquid dose from a vial and return the syringe to its rack.
comparison.physical_skill: Needle insertion, bimanual syringe stabilization, plunger control and precise restowing.
comparison.success_condition: 9–11 ml liquid, at most 1 ml air, needle removed, syringe upright and released, arms returned.
comparison.reason: Tests metered fluid acquisition with simultaneous barrel/plunger control rather than fastener unlocking, collar tuning and impact-response verification.
